title: Integrations

hints.gateways: The gateway marked for subscription payments collects SaaS invoices from institutes. A gateway offered to institutes is their fee-collection fallback: an institute's own enabled gateway always takes precedence. Credentials are encrypted at rest, and enabling a gateway runs a connection test first.
hints.messaging: Platform defaults per channel. They send login OTPs and act as the fallback for institutes without a provider of their own; an institute's provider always takes precedence. Without one the built-in console provider logs messages instead of sending them.
hints.live: The media server that carries live-class audio and video, records classes and reports attendance.
hints.storage: Where uploaded files (documents, media, exports) are stored for every institute. Credentials are encrypted at rest.

test.notTested: Not tested yet. Enabling runs a connection test first.

copyFailed: Copy failed; select the URL instead

gateway.mockNote: Simulated payments for development and testing. It can't be enabled in production.
gateway.offerToInstitutes: Offer to institutes without their own fee gateway
gateway.secretAgain: Sandbox and live use different keys: enter the {field} for {mode} mode.
gateway.removeMessage: Its saved credentials are deleted and it stops taking payments.

testHelp.sms: Send test sends the login OTP text (123456 is your verification code…) through the OTP template
testHelp.whatsapp: Send test uses it; enabling an untested configuration needs a passing test or key check
testHelp.email: Send test uses it; enabling an untested configuration sends a test here first
testHelp.push: Send test uses it; enabling an untested configuration needs a passing test or key check

messaging.testTemplateHelp: WhatsApp sends approved templates only: use one without variables
messaging.removeMessage: Its saved credentials are deleted and messages fall back to the built-in console provider.

storage.title: File storage
storage.note: Local disk keeps files in the server's storage directory. Switching drivers doesn't copy existing files: move them to the new location before activating it. Without an active configuration the server default is used.
storage.s3Note: The S3-compatible adapter isn't included in this build yet, so its connection test fails until it is implemented.

live.vendorNote: Set on the server with STREAMING_PROVIDER and the LIVEKIT_* settings (see docs/integrations/live-streaming.md). Secrets are never shown here.
live.devNote: The built-in development provider connects browsers to each other through the classroom socket with public STUN servers only, so it works on one network but not across most mobile or office networks. Set STREAMING_PROVIDER=livekit on the server for production classes.
live.webhookNote: Webhook URL to configure on the LiveKit server or Cloud project — attendance and recordings come from it:
